2, Improved recognition of temperature sensor subdevice for climate devices
3, Changed default opmode for devices without an opmode to "auto" instead of "fan_only", for better clarity and to avoid misunderstandings

issue_context.title: Fibaro integration/partly missing Danfoss HC10
issue_context.body:

Only device 228.0 (Fibaro id 229) and 228.11 (fibaro id 251), 228.12 (fibaro id 252) are inegrated and shown in HA. I suppose there might be an issue with this device integration within fibaro-ha intergration.

Please check and through this help me out. ´=)

comments:
Tha Fibaro - HA integration does a trick to combine the various elements of a single climate device from the fibaro devices. So ultimately it creates a device with joint functionality, which combines the sensor device, the target_temp device, the opmode device and the fanmode device.
It seems you have a controller which combines into one parent device a lot of zones, each with its opmode and setpoint device. The current integration does not know how to represent that.
It seems like the devices could be grouped and separated based on the endPointID field. If you'd like to help me develop/debug this, please contact me at peter dot balogh2 at gmail dot com, or on the HA Discord server.

review_comments: @ctalkington I think that's the closest it gets to, so yes.

Remember that there is a device and there's fibaro home center. So it could get its smarts from multiple places. All we know for sure is that this device has not exposed to us a way to get or set its operating mode, only its target temperature usually. So we don't know whether it's a heating, cooling or a fan device. All we know it exists and we can set a temperature target to it and it'll somehow do something with it.
